## About
Costello's Plumbing is a local plumbing company on Anza Way in San Leandro, run by Gary, the owner. Our mission is simple: honest, reliable residential and commercial plumbing, with each repair completed correctly.
We use the very best equipment, supplies and techniques for plumbing installations and repairs, and we'll always give you a clear assessment of what your job will require before we start.
Neighbors get to know our plumbers by name. Reviewers mention Alex and Miguel, and one customer said they were glad to be supporting a local business. We're rated 4.9 from 65 Google reviews.

## Services
- Sinks, Drains & Faucets: From a simple faucet installation to clogged kitchen sinks and slow drains.
- Toilets: Toilets that won't flush right, clogs, and new toilet installs. One reviewer said Alex picked up a new toilet and installed it the same day.
- Garbage Disposals: Garbage disposal repairs and installations.
- Water Heaters: Water heater repairs and installations for homes and businesses.
- Sewer Inspections: Complete sewer line inspections so you know what's going on underground.
- Pipe Repairs: Repairs to broken and leaking pipes, including outdoor water lines.
- Water Treatment Systems: Water treatment systems for your home or business.
- Leaks & Clogs: Finding and fixing leaks, and clearing clogs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on homes or businesses?
A: Both. We offer a wide range of residential and commercial plumbing services.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call or text (510) 415-0725 and one of our plumbers will get you started with a quote.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Saturday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed Sunday.

Q: If I email or use the contact form, when will I hear back?
A: If needed, you'll hear back within 48-72 hours. For anything sooner, call or text us.

I know that a lot of online reviews are fake, but I thought that if Costello's plumbers are even half as good as the reviews claim it will be OK. He purchased a new toilet and came right back and installed it the same day.  The new toilet worked great until yesterday when it got clogged.  Alex came today, plunged it and strongly recommended a replacement for our ancient plunger.  From now on we will call Costello's anytime we need a plumber." (Catharina Howard, 5/5)
